oid = d["id"]

# 2. order with 1 item + remark

oid2 = j2["data"]["id"]

# 3. empty items -> 400

j = r.json(); print("empty:", j); assert j["code"] == 400 and j["message"] == "订单项不能为空", j

# 4. missing items key -> 400
r = requests.post(f"{base}/api/orders", json={"remark": "x"}, headers=hu, timeout=10)

# 5. bad dish id -> 400 菜品不存在: id=

# 6. failed submission leaves no rows: count orders before/after a mixed valid+invalid submission
before = requests.get(f"{base}/api/orders", headers=hu, timeout=10).json()["data"]
r = requests.post(f"{base}/api/orders", json={"items": [{"dishId": ids[0], "quantity": 1}, {"dishId": 999999, "quantity": 1}]}, headers=hu, timeout=10)

assert r.json()["data"]["status"] == "CANCELLED"
